📝 Beautify

Beautify automatically formats text in your clipboard using transliteration rules.

⌘ Cmd + Shift + X
How to use:
  1. Copy any text to your clipboard
  2. Press Cmd+Shift+X (or Ctrl+Shift+X on Windows)
  3. Your clipboard now contains the beautified text!

🎯 Try it now:

1. Select and copy the text above
2. Press Cmd+Shift+X (or Ctrl+Shift+X)
3. Paste it back here to see the replacement!
